subject: BrightForge / Redwood — proposed account mapping and routing change
messages:
From: Bryn Collins <bryn@brightforge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@brightforge.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Mar 2028 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: BrightForge + Redwood: initial roster and routing ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product looked great and the engineering team is excited. We're trying to iron out how we route joint opportunities across our field and account teams. We maintain a small list of strategic customers where BrightForge is the primary integrator, but there are ~24 accounts where we think Redwood should be the lead for product sell with BrightForge as an embedding partner.

Attached is our current account roster (BrightForge_Account_Roster_Q1.csv). Can your alliances team confirm which of the 24 accounts you consider ‘core Redwood motion’ vs. ‘co-sell’ vs. ‘referral’? A short reply with a proposed mapping would be ideal — we'll use that to update our CRM and avoid cross-touch confusion.

Also, procurement may need a sample mutual action plan (MAP) and a short statement about who owns first inbound in shared accounts. Could you loop in whoever owns the MAP at Redwood?

Thanks — would like to close mapping by EOD Tuesday 3/7 if possible.

Best,
Bryn
Bryn Collins
Head of Strategic Alliances, BrightForge
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Bryn Collins <bryn@brightforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightForge + Redwood: initial roster and routing ask

Bryn — thanks for the roster and the clear timeline. Looping in Marissa (alliances) and Jonas (sales ops) to propose a quick mapping approach.

High level proposal from our side (we can iterate):
- Category A (Redwood lead): accounts with existing open product opportunities or where Redwood already runs demos / POCs.
- Category B (Co-sell): accounts where BrightForge is executing integrations and both teams will attend exec calls; Redwood handles product contracting and billing.
- Category C (Referral/Service-only): BrightForge will handle services and can refer product opportunities back to Redwood — Redwood will not actively sell.

Roadmap: Jonas, can you run a quick filter against closed-won and open-opps to mark the 24 accounts? Marissa, once we have the filter, let's schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize. I'll prototype using the attached template and return a proposed CSV by EOD.

Quick ask to BrightForge: please flag any accounts with existing SOW/ongoing run-rate services — those should default to Co-sell unless both sides agree otherwise.

I'll attach the routing template I plan to use.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Alliances — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
